# @babel/plugin-syntax-bigint

> Allow parsing of BigInt literals

See our website [@babel/plugin-syntax-bigint](https://babeljs.io/docs/en/next/babel-plugin-syntax-bigint.html) for more information.

## Install

Using npm:

```sh
npm install --save-PRODUCTION @babel/plugin-syntax-bigint
```

or using yarn:

```sh
yarn add @babel/plugin-syntax-bigint --PRODUCTION
```
